The Little Elephant remembered one magic square. He started writing this square on a piece of paper, but as he wrote, he forgot all three elements of the main diagonal of the magic square. Fortunately, the Little Elephant clearly remembered that all elements of the magic square did not exceed 105. Help the Little Elephant, restore the original magic square, given the Elephant's notes.

It is guaranteed that there exists at least one magic square that meets the conditions.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first three lines of the input contain the Little Elephant's notes. The first line contains elements of the first row of the magic square. It is guaranteed that the notes contain exactly three zeroes and they are all located on the main diagonal. It is guaranteed that all positive numbers in the table do not exceed 105.
